name: Claude Skills Toolkit
headline: comprehensive claude skills toolkit
short_description: A toolkit for creating, testing, and refining Claude Code skills with enforced conventions, best practices, and empirical validation built in from the start.
author: full-stack-biz

sections.overview:
Claude Skills Toolkit is a plugin for building and managing Claude Code skills with convention enforcement and structured workflows. It includes skill-composer for creating new skills with best practices enforced upfront, skill-refiner for optimizing existing skills, skill-tester for empirical benchmarking, and plugin-creator for packaging skills as installable plugins. The toolkit solves the problem of inconsistent skill quality and documentation drift by turning knowledge into interactive, testable guidance that teams can install once and reuse. It's designed for teams building production-ready skills that follow standardized patterns and can be validated before deployment.
Create release management skills from internal documentation and process guides
Build and benchmark code review workflow skills with pass/fail metrics
Package team processes as installable plugins for consistent execution
Optimize existing skills for token efficiency and production readiness
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/full-stack-biz/claude-skills-toolkit`
sections.usage:
```
Act as a skills toolkit for Claude Code. I need to automate a repetitive task in [SOFTWARE]. The task involves [DESCRIBE TASK]. Generate a step-by-step guide with code snippets to automate this task using Claude Code.
```
